caption: The drawing is presented on a beige or light tan background and consists primarily of black ink outlines. The upper part of the drawing displays two horizontal zigzag patterns labeled “Plain Braid folded into Rick-Rack, Front” and “Back,” both drawn as a series of connected triangles. Next to these, there are two small icons labeled “Black Iron Hooks & Eyes. Actual Size,” which show a hook and an eye from a fastening device. The lower part of the drawing features a long, continuous decorative border composed of a repeating floral motif. This motif consists of spirals, leaf-like shapes, and small oval elements arranged in a symmetrical, undulating pattern, with dotted lines accentuating the design. The rows of motifs are placed inside a lightly outlined rectangular band. The entire drawing uses only shades of black and gray on a plain background without any additional color.
title: Dress (detail)
